prompt_en: A photographic scene in a small neighborhood toy-repair studio: an adult woman, authored as a 27-year-old toy restorer, shares a visible hands-on moment with a palm-sized plush seal. Use the supplied reference for the visible face and hair. Her dark chin-length bob and airy fringe frame the reference facial features, with natural adult proportions. Seated behind a low wooden workbench, she cups the little seal upright in her left palm while her right thumb and forefinger gently unfold its bent cloth flipper; both wrists stay close together above the bench. The toy has a rounded pear-shaped body, small stitched eyes, a blunt muzzle and soft, stubby flippers. A fresh hand-sewn patch on its belly is visible between her supporting fingers. The seal's underside settles fully into her supporting palm, a shallow fabric indentation meeting the skin along a narrow soft contact shadow that follows the broad window light. Her eyes lift briefly toward the photographer, the corners of her mouth curving into a small, pleased smile, as if sharing the tiny repair's success. She wears an oatmeal scoop-neck knit top with sleeves pushed to her forearms and a worn walnut-colored work apron; the relaxed neckline and easy eye contact give her a quiet, everyday adult appeal. A thread spool and folded fabric scraps sit lower on the bench, subordinate to her hands and the toy. A broad window lights the face, fingertips and brushed fabric softly. Photograph from across the workbench at her upper-chest height in a three-quarter medium view, keeping her complete head, both forearms, the seal and its contact with her hands readable. Use a natural 50mm perspective with sufficient depth to resolve the fresh stitches; softly receding shelves establish the working room. The visual rhythm is her amused face, the careful paired hands, then the small rounded creature they protect.
